subject.title: refactor(providers): scope proxy trust across model discovery (owner review)

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this shared canonical-origin proxy trust model across the listed provider catalogs, including the Bedrock and Google Chat transport adapters?
rationale: The diff intentionally changes a cross-plugin SSRF and proxy-routing boundary; tests can show mechanics, but they cannot select the permanent trust policy or its accepted compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Approve the scoped model
options.body: Confirm canonical HTTPS provider endpoints may use environment proxy routing while custom, local, cleartext, redirected, and operator-configured origins remain strict.

options.title: Narrow the initial scope
options.body: Land only the providers whose canonical-origin and upgrade behavior the owner is ready to support, leaving the remaining adapters for focused follow-ups.

options.title: Pause for a policy redesign
options.body: Do not merge the consolidation until the proxy-trust contract is simplified or documented more narrowly.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped model
recommendation.body: Confirm canonical HTTPS provider endpoints may use environment proxy routing while custom, local, cleartext, redirected, and operator-configured origins remain strict.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history, assignment, and PR body identify steipete as the owner-review path for this consolidated security boundary.
